#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class CF111C {
public:
    CF111C() {}
    void run() {
        main_func();
    }

private:
    int encode(const vector<int>& aa, int m) {
        int a = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
            a = a * 3 + aa[j];
        return a;
    }

    void decode(vector<int>& aa, int m, int a, int base) {
        for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            aa[j] = a % base;
            a /= base;
        }
    }

    void main_func() {
        int n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        if (n < m) {
            int tmp = n; n = m; m = tmp;
        }
        int p = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
            p *= 3;

        vector<int> dp(p, -1);
        vector<int> dq(p, -1);
        vector<int> aa(m, 1);
        vector<int> bb(m);

        dp[encode(aa, m)] = 0;

        while (n-- > 0) {
            fill(dq.begin(), dq.end(), -1);
            for (int a = 0; a < p; a++) {
                if (dp[a] < 0)
                    continue;
                decode(aa, m, a, 3);
                for (int b = 0; b < (1 << m); b++) {
                    decode(bb, m, b, 2);
                    bool bad = false;
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                        if (aa[j] == 0 && bb[j] == 0) {
                            bad = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    if (bad)
                        continue;
                    int cnt = 0;
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                        if (bb[j] == 1) {
                            bb[j] = 2;
                            cnt++;
                        }
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                        if (bb[j] == 0 && (aa[j] == 2 || (j > 0 && bb[j - 1] == 2) || (j + 1 < m && bb[j + 1] == 2)))
                            bb[j] = 1;
                    int a_ = encode(bb, m);
                    dq[a_] = max(dq[a_], dp[a] + m - cnt);
                }
            }
            swap(dp, dq);
        }

        int ans = 0;
        for (int a = 0; a < p; a++) {
            if (dp[a] <= ans)
                continue;
            vector<int> aa_local(m);
            decode(aa_local, m, a, 3);
            bool bad = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                if (aa_local[j] == 0) {
                    bad = true;
                    break;
                }
            if (!bad)
                ans = max(ans, dp[a]);
        }
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    CF111C obj;
    obj.run();
    return 0;
}
